div.div: 5 تدجّج فِى شِكَّتِهِ , (S, and so in copies of the K,) or ↓ تَدَجْدَجَ , (A, and so in the K accord. to the TA,) He covered himself with his arms, or weapons: (A:) or he attired himself with (lit. entered into) his arms; (S, K;) as though he covered himself with them. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
